subject: Post-call: StratoLink technical deep-dive — topology & SLOs
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@stratolink.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-02T15:03:00Z
Subject: Post-call: StratoLink technical deep-dive — topology & SLOs
Attachments: mutual-action-plan-stratolink.xlsx, stratolink-llm-profile.csv

Hi Alex / Jordan —

Thanks for the time today. Quick write-up to capture what we agreed on during the call and make the PoC handoff explicit. I kept this high level; please flag anything I mis-stated.

Call high-level takeaways (pain / goal):
- Pain: unpredictable latency spikes during morning bursts and poor cold-start throughput when you scale to new models. Also, per-token costs for the 13B models are higher than expected during peak.
- Primary goals: p95 latency target for interactive product flows <= 120ms for ~512-token generation; sustained throughput target ~200 req/s for the conversational endpoint with 95th percentile spikes handled via graceful degradation. Budget target: minimize marginal per-token spend (targeting cost-per-1k-tokens under your current threshold).

Model / workload constraints we discussed:
- Primary models: Llama-3-derived 13B quantized variant for responses; smaller 7B distilled variant for boosted routing on cheap paths.
- Typical sequence lengths: prompt ~120 tokens + generation average 180 tokens, peaks to 800 tokens for longer responses.
- Session affinity required for chat (KV cache reuse across requests).

Topology & SLO mapping (Redwood suggestion):
- Hot path: Dedicated GPU pool (NVIDIA H100-class equiv) pinned to the 13B quantized variant for low-latency interactive traffic.
- Warm path: Dedicated medium pool for 7B variant used for fallback and reranking.
- Fallback: Hosted shared capacity as a backstop for extreme bursts (auto-failover with model-variant compatibility).
- Caching: prefix KV caching + warmed memory snapshots for common prompts. We recommend pre-warm during your traffic windows and a 15-minute warm-cache TTL for conversational sessions.
- Autoscaling: throughput-based quick scale (scale-up in under 30s) with soft limits to prevent runaway cost.

Suggested SLOs (proposal) — please confirm or modify:
- p50 / p95 / p99 generation latency (512 token budget): 30ms / 120ms / 450ms
- Successful response rate (no fallback) >= 99% under normal load
- Warm-start behavior: p95 latency when cache warm <= 80ms

Mutual action plan (attachments) — top items:
1) Redwood PoC (owner: Karthik) — 48 hour run: mirror ~48h of representative traffic (you'll provide a sanitized sample), run at target concurrency with p95/p99 measurements. (Deliverable: PoC report + logs).
2) Security & compliance kickoff (owner: Jordan) — exchange of SOC2 artifacts and required evidence; Redwood to provide a short evidence pack.
3) Topology validation (owner: Hannah) — config for VPC peering, private endpoints, and dev/test subnet mapping.
4) Pricing check (owner: Alex) — finalize expected unit economics for 2M tokens/day profile.

Next steps / asks from StratoLink:
- Provide a 48-hour sample traffic dump (sanitized) and a list of top-50 prompts to pre-warm KV.
- Confirm which flows require strict session affinity vs one-off requests.
- Provide a primary point of contact for procurement (for early pricing discussion).

I'll attach a short mutual-action-plan spreadsheet with owners and tentative dates. Proposed timeline: PoC kickoff next week (Nov 6 start) if sample traffic is available by Nov 4.

Thanks again — happy to jump on a quick 30m follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mutual-action-plan-stratolink.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)]
[Attachment: stratolink-llm-profile.csv (csv, 12KB)]

From: Alex Mercer <alex@stratolink.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@stratolink.com>
Date: 2028-11-02T17:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: StratoLink technical deep-dive — topology & SLOs

Irene — thanks for the summary and the clear next steps. Everything looks accurate from our side. Two quick clarifications:  
1) We can provide the 48h sanitized traffic by Friday (Nov 4). We will strip any PII and deliver via the secure Drive link.
2) For the PoC, we want to run one run with session affinity enabled and one without, to see the delta for KV warmups.

Procurement: I'll loop in procurement this week but for the initial PoC we just need a commercial estimate to budget. We'll confirm whether we want the dedicated pool during PoC or if shared capacity is fine for the first run.

Happy to start Nov 6. If you could send the exact test plan and the scripts you want us to run that would be great.

—Alex
Alex Mercer
Head of ML Platform, StratoLink
[Attachment: none]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-11-02T18:05:00Z

Forwarding Alex's ack. Internal notes and quick operational asks:  

On 2028-11-02 17:20, Alex Mercer <alex@stratolink.com> wrote:  
> Irene — thanks for the summary and the clear next steps. Everything looks accurate from our side. ...

Internal action items I propose (assigning owners):
- PoC lead & orchestration: Karthik (I'll lead the run, coordinate infra changes, and produce PoC report).
- Infra config & network: Hannah (VPC peering, private endpoints, subnets, and firewall rules).
- Dev test scripts: Irene to draft canonical test harness; I'll convert to Redwood runner and add tracing hooks.
- Pre-warm plan: request DevOps to pre-warm KV snapshots 1 hour before test windows (Hannah to confirm operational feasibility).
- Cost estimate: I'll work with pricing to produce a short line-item estimate for dedicated vs shared PoC, aiming to keep the PoC under the budget cap Alex hinted at.

Immediate asks:  
- Irene: share the test script template + exact metrics we want logged (p50/p95/p99, token counts, cache-hit rates).
- Hannah: can you validate whether we can expose a private endpoint in the EU west region for this test if StratoLink prefers to keep traffic regional (they are US first, but asked about regional options).

I'll block time in our calendars for a pre-run sync on Nov 5 (30m). If anyone prefers a different owner mapping, say now.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
